concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) specifies that predictors with VIF > 5 must be *removed* before model training (iterative VIF removal). The current task T010 only computes VIF and flags collinearity; no task performs the required removal step, leaving the plan element uncovered.

Plan document introduces a new functional requirement FR-010, which does not exist in the specification. No task in tasks.md is tagged for or implements FR-010, so the plan element lacks any corresponding task.
